title: The fake police officer
description: A "detective" warns you about burglars and wants to collect your valuables.
opening: Good afternoon, this is Detective Weber from the criminal police. Please don't be alarmed, but we arrested burglars in your street last night.
caller_goal: Get the person to hand cash and jewellery to a 'colleague' who comes by for safekeeping.
tactics: secrecy: 'tell no one, the bank is involved'
red_flags: Police want to collect money or valuables
